sources.name: O*NET 29.1 Occupational Database (15-2051.00 Data Scientists, 15-1252.00 Software Developers)
European Skills, Competences, Qualifications and Occupations (ESCO v1.2)
Verified Official Documentation (Python.org, MDN, PyTorch, scikit-learn, Hugging Face, PostgreSQL, Docker)

goals.title: Become an AI Engineer
goals.description: Design, build, evaluate, and deploy production artificial intelligence systems, including machine learning pipelines, deep learning models, LLM applications, and retrieval-augmented generation architectures.

goals.title: Become a Machine Learning Engineer
goals.description: Architect, train, optimize, validate, and serve scalable machine learning and deep learning models in production environments.

goals.title: Become a Data Scientist
goals.description: Extract actionable insights from complex datasets using statistical inference, exploratory data analysis, predictive modeling, and data visualization.

goals.title: Become a Full-Stack Developer
goals.description: Build complete end-to-end web applications combining semantic frontend interfaces, reactive state management, relational databases, and secure backend APIs.

goals.title: Learn web development from the beginning
goals.description: Master modern web development from first principles: HTML5, CSS layout systems, JavaScript programming, version control, TypeScript, and interactive React applications.

goals.title: Build and deploy an AI application using an LLM
goals.description: Focused project path to architect, validate, wrap in a web API, and deploy a reliable Large Language Model application using pretrained models without requiring deep learning training from scratch.
keywords: build and deploy an ai application

goals.title: Learn the skills required to build a retrieval-augmented generation application
goals.description: Master document chunking, dense vector embeddings, hybrid search indexing, grounded prompt synthesis, and citation faithfulness evaluation to build production RAG pipelines.

skills.description: Core Python syntax, control flow, functions, modular packaging, virtual environments, type annotations, file I/O, and built-in data structures (lists, dicts, sets, tuples, generators).
skills.why_relevant: Serves as the primary programming language for data processing, machine learning libraries, backend services, and AI orchestration.
skills.completion_criteria: Write a modular Python CLI package using type hints, custom exceptions, list/dict comprehensions, and unit tests with pytest.
skills.diagnostic_check: Can you implement a generator function that streams and filters JSONL records with proper exception handling and type annotations?
suggested_exercises: Build a log parser that aggregates error frequencies using collections.Counter and defaultdict.
Create a typed data validation class using dataclasses and custom property validators.
skills.mini_project: CLI Dataset Inspector: Parse CSV/JSON datasets, compute summary statistics, and export clean reports.
skills.source_reference: O*NET 15-2051.00 / ESCO Python Programming / docs.python.org

skills.description: Track source code history, manage branches, resolve merge conflicts, write atomic commits, and structure reproducible repositories.
skills.why_relevant: Essential for managing code experiments, collaborating on engineering teams, and deploying reproducible software and ML pipelines.
skills.completion_criteria: Create a multi-branch repository, perform interactive rebasing, resolve a simulated merge conflict, and configure .gitignore rules for data/weights.
skills.diagnostic_check: Do you know how to isolate a feature on a branch, resolve a conflict during rebase, and undo a bad commit using git reflog?
suggested_exercises: Initialize a Git repo, create feature branches, and resolve an intentional two-branch conflict.
Configure pre-commit hooks to prevent committing secrets or large binary artifacts.
skills.mini_project: Versioned Engineering Template: Set up a clean multi-branch repository with automated commit hygiene.
skills.source_reference: O*NET 15-1252.00 / Official Pro Git Book (git-scm.com)

skills.description: Design normalized relational schemas, query data with joins, aggregations, CTEs, and window functions, and manage transactions in SQLite and PostgreSQL.
skills.why_relevant: Every AI, data science, and full-stack system relies on structured persistence for training datasets, user records, and application state.
skills.completion_criteria: Design a normalized 4-table schema with foreign keys and write queries using Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions (ROW_NUMBER, LAG).
skills.diagnostic_check: Can you write a SQL query using a CTE and PARTITION BY window function to rank the top 3 events per user without a self-join?
suggested_exercises: Write analytical queries joining learner, skill, and progress tables with GROUP BY HAVING clauses.
Index a high-cardinality lookup column and inspect the query plan using EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN.
skills.mini_project: Feature Store Schema in SQLite/PostgreSQL: Store user events and compute rolling 7-day behavioral aggregates in SQL.
skills.source_reference: O*NET 15-2051.00 / PostgreSQL Official Documentation & SQLBolt

skills.skill_name: Linear Algebra & Multivariable Calculus for ML
skills.description: Vectors, vector spaces, dot products, matrix multiplication, eigendecomposition, partial derivatives, gradients, and the chain rule.
skills.why_relevant: Forms the mathematical backbone of vector embeddings, cosine similarity, neural network forward passes, and backpropagation.
skills.completion_criteria: Implement matrix multiplication, cosine similarity, and numerical gradient descent from scratch and explain how the chain rule updates weights.
skills.diagnostic_check: Can you compute the cosine similarity between two vectors by hand and derive the gradient of squared error loss with respect to a weight vector?
suggested_exercises: Compute dot products, L2 norms, and cosine distances on 128-dimensional vectors.
Minimize a two-variable quadratic objective function using analytical gradients.
skills.mini_project: Gradient Descent Visualizer: Optimize linear regression parameters using pure matrix calculus.
skills.source_reference: O*NET 15-2051.00 Mathematics / Mathematics for Machine Learning (Deisenroth et al.)

skills.description: Probability distributions, conditional probability, Bayes' theorem, hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, maximum likelihood estimation, and bias-variance tradeoffs.
skills.why_relevant: Crucial for understanding model uncertainty, calibrated confidence scores, A/B experimentation, and generative sampling temperatures.
skills.completion_criteria: Apply Bayes' theorem to classifier calibration, conduct a two-sample hypothesis test, and quantify confidence intervals via bootstrapping.
skills.diagnostic_check: Can you explain the difference between a model's uncalibrated logit score and a calibrated posterior probability?
suggested_exercises: Simulate central limit theorem convergence and compute 95% bootstrap confidence intervals.
Evaluate classifier calibration using Brier score and reliability diagrams.
skills.mini_project: Statistical A/B Evaluation Harness: Compare two model variants with statistical significance testing.
skills.source_reference: O*NET 15-2051.00 / OpenIntro Statistics & Seeing Theory

skills.description: N-dimensional arrays (ndarray), broadcasting rules, vectorized mathematical operations, slicing, linear algebra routines (numpy.linalg), and memory-efficient array manipulation.
skills.why_relevant: Provides the core tensor and array abstraction underneath pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, and embedding similarity calculations.
skills.completion_criteria: Replace nested Python loops with vectorized NumPy broadcasting to compute pairwise cosine similarity across 10,000 vectors in under 50ms.
skills.diagnostic_check: Can you explain how NumPy broadcasting aligns arrays of shapes (1000, 384) and (1, 384) without copying memory?
suggested_exercises: Implement batch z-score standardization and pairwise Euclidean/cosine distance matrices using pure NumPy.
Implement a 2-layer perceptron forward and backward pass using only numpy.dot and broadcasting.
skills.mini_project: In-Memory Vector Similarity Engine: Build a fast top-k nearest neighbor search engine in pure NumPy.
skills.source_reference: ESCO Scientific Computing / Official NumPy User Guide (numpy.org)

skills.description: DataFrames, Series, missing value imputation, multi-index grouping, merging relational datasets, time-series resampling, and schema validation.
skills.why_relevant: Real-world AI and ML systems spend 60%+ of engineering effort cleaning, joining, deduplicating, and preparing structured and semi-structured data.
skills.completion_criteria: Build an automated data cleaning pipeline that ingests raw CSV/JSON logs, handles missing values without data leakage, and exports clean Parquet/SQLite tables.
skills.diagnostic_check: How do you merge two DataFrames with different key granularities and impute missing group values without leaking test set statistics?
suggested_exercises: Clean a noisy occupational dataset with duplicate skill names, mixed date formats, and null values.
Aggregate time-stamped user study sessions into weekly rolling metrics using groupby and resample.
skills.mini_project: Automated Curriculum Data Normalizer: Ingest and normalize O*NET and ESCO CSV records into clean relational tables.
skills.source_reference: O*NET 15-2051.00 / Official pandas User Guide (pandas.pydata.org)

skills.description: Uncover distributions, correlations, anomalies, and class imbalances using Matplotlib, Seaborn, and structured statistical summaries.
skills.why_relevant: Essential for diagnosing dataset bias, outliers, and feature distributions before training models or designing retrieval pipelines.
skills.completion_criteria: Produce a reproducible EDA diagnostic report identifying feature skewness, collinearity, and target leakage across a real-world dataset.
skills.diagnostic_check: Which plots and statistical metrics would you use to detect heavy-tailed distributions and multicollinearity across 30 features?
suggested_exercises: Create distribution, correlation heatmap, and calibration residual plots using Matplotlib/Seaborn.
Build a class-imbalance audit script for multi-label skill classification.
skills.mini_project: Dataset Quality & Bias Diagnostic Report: Visual and statistical audit of a benchmark dataset.
skills.source_reference: O*NET 15-2051.00 / Matplotlib & Seaborn Official Documentation

skills.description: Linear/logistic regression, decision trees, random forests, gradient boosted trees, SVMs, k-means clustering, PCA dimensionality reduction, and regularisation.
skills.why_relevant: Provides interpretable, compute-efficient baseline models and classification/ranking algorithms essential for structured data and hybrid AI systems.
skills.completion_criteria: Train, tune, and compare regularized linear models and gradient boosted trees using scikit-learn Pipelines with stratified cross-validation.
skills.diagnostic_check: Why must feature scaling and imputation be fitted inside a Pipeline fold rather than on the full dataset prior to train_test_split?
suggested_exercises: Train a multi-class skill-relevance classifier using LogisticRegression and HistGradientBoostingClassifier.
Apply PCA and k-means clustering to group technical skills by occupational co-occurrence.
skills.mini_project: Role-to-Skill Relevance Classifier: Predict whether a technical skill is essential for a target career role.
skills.source_reference: O*NET 15-2051.00 / scikit-learn Official User Guide (scikit-learn.org)

skills.description: Categorical encoding, numerical scaling, text vectorization (TF-IDF), interaction terms, ColumnTransformer composition, and zero-leakage preprocessing pipelines.
skills.why_relevant: High-quality domain features and leak-free preprocessing pipelines consistently yield larger performance gains than model complexity alone.
skills.completion_criteria: Construct a scikit-learn ColumnTransformer combining TF-IDF text features, target encoding, and numeric scaling that serializes cleanly for inference.
skills.diagnostic_check: How do you handle unseen categorical levels and missing numeric fields at production inference time?
suggested_exercises: Build a custom scikit-learn Transformer mixin that extracts domain signals from job descriptions.
Verify zero data leakage across 5-fold time-based cross-validation.
skills.mini_project: End-to-End Feature Pipeline: Serialize a repeatable preprocessing + classification pipeline.
skills.source_reference: ESCO Machine Learning Engineering / scikit-learn Pipeline Documentation

skills.description: Confusion matrices (TP, TN, FP, FN), accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, ROC-AUC, precision-recall curves, threshold tuning, and probability calibration.
skills.why_relevant: Prevents deploying unreliable models by rigorously quantifying error modes, false positives vs false negatives, and calibration quality.
skills.completion_criteria: Compute confusion matrix metrics (TP, TN, FP, FN, Precision, Recall, F1) on a held-out test set and select an optimal decision threshold for asymmetric error costs.
skills.diagnostic_check: When evaluating a rare-class classifier (5% positive rate), why can 95% accuracy be completely useless, and how do Precision and Recall expose this?
suggested_exercises: Implement precision, recall, F1-score, and confusion matrix calculations from raw predictions and ground-truth labels.
Perform slice-based error analysis to identify underperforming categories.
skills.mini_project: ML Evaluation & Calibration Suite: Automated test harness reporting confusion matrices and F1 metrics.
skills.source_reference: O*NET 15-2051.00 / scikit-learn Model Evaluation Documentation

skills.description: Tensors, automatic differentiation (autograd), neural network layers, activation functions, loss functions, AdamW optimization, regularization, and Transformer attention mechanisms.
skills.why_relevant: Underpins modern representation learning, embeddings, computer vision, and Large Language Models.
skills.completion_criteria: Build, train, and evaluate a custom PyTorch neural network with a modular Dataset/DataLoader, training loop, validation checkpointing, and attention block.
skills.diagnostic_check: Why must optimizer.zero_grad() be called before loss.backward(), and what changes when switching a PyTorch model from model.train() to model.eval()?
suggested_exercises: Implement scaled dot-product self-attention in PyTorch and verify tensor dimensions.
Train a text classification model with early stopping and learning rate scheduling.
skills.mini_project: Custom Neural Text & Skill Embedder in PyTorch: Train a dual-encoder network to match learner goals with skills.
skills.source_reference: ESCO Deep Learning / Official PyTorch Tutorials (pytorch.org/tutorials)

skills.skill_name: Large Language Models & Structured Output Engineering
skills.description: Tokenization, context windows, sampling parameters (temperature, top_p), system instructions, few-shot grounding, JSON Schema enforcement, and local inference with Ollama.
skills.why_relevant: Core competency for building deterministic, schema-validated AI applications that integrate cleanly with software backends rather than returning unstructured essays.
skills.completion_criteria: Build a Python service that calls a local Ollama model with a strict Pydantic JSON Schema, validates the structured output, and executes automated repair on schema failures.
skills.diagnostic_check: How do you constrain an LLM to emit valid JSON adhering to a Pydantic schema and handle truncated or hallucinated keys?
suggested_exercises: Configure Ollama locally, inspect model templates, and compare outputs at temperature=0.1 vs 0.8.
Build a Pydantic validator with a 1-step repair retry loop for structured curriculum extraction.
skills.mini_project: Structured JSON Curriculum Extractor: Convert unstructured syllabi into validated dependency graphs via Ollama.
skills.source_reference: Ollama API Documentation (github.com/ollama/ollama) & Hugging Face NLP Course

skills.description: Text embedding models, chunking strategies, cosine/dot-product similarity indexing, hybrid lexical + dense retrieval (BM25 + vector), and re-ranking.
skills.why_relevant: Enables semantic retrieval over curated knowledge bases so AI systems ground responses in authoritative facts.
skills.completion_criteria: Index 5,000 technical documentation chunks using dense embeddings + BM25 and measure Recall@5 and Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR).
skills.diagnostic_check: Why does combining sparse lexical search (BM25) with dense vector embeddings outperform vector-only search on exact technical identifiers?
suggested_exercises: Compare fixed-token chunking vs structure-aware markdown chunking on retrieval accuracy.
Implement reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) combining keyword and vector similarity scores.
skills.mini_project: Hybrid Technical Docs Search Engine: Retrieve exact skill and documentation passages with Recall@5 evaluation.
skills.source_reference: Hugging Face Embeddings Guide & Sentence-Transformers Documentation

skills.description: End-to-end RAG pipelines: query rewriting, context assembly, source attribution, citation verification, hallucination guardrails, and fallback handling when evidence is missing.
skills.why_relevant: Allows AI systems to synthesize personalized plans and technical answers strictly grounded in verified datasets without fabricating URLs or facts.
skills.completion_criteria: Build a grounded RAG pipeline that cites verified source IDs for every claim and abstains cleanly when the knowledge base lacks supporting evidence.
skills.diagnostic_check: How do you prevent a RAG system from inventing URLs or attributing hallucinated facts to retrieved context chunks?
suggested_exercises: Build a post-generation verifier that cross-checks every resource ID and URL against the authoritative database.
Implement context window budgeting and relevance filtering before prompt assembly.
skills.mini_project: Verified Documentation RAG Assistant: Grounded technical Q&A and planner with strict citation validation.
skills.source_reference: Hugging Face Advanced RAG Guide & LlamaIndex/LangChain Architectural Patterns

skills.skill_name: AI System Evaluation, Guardrails & Reliability Testing
skills.description: Deterministic schema validation, faithfulness and groundedness checks, regression test suites for prompts, latency budgets, and fallback engineering.
skills.why_relevant: Production AI engineering requires verifiable quality guarantees, automated error detection, and graceful degradation when models fail.
skills.completion_criteria: Create an automated evaluation suite testing schema compliance, prerequisite graph validity, resource integrity, and classification F1 metrics.
skills.diagnostic_check: How do you design an automated test suite that catches hallucinated skill IDs, circular dependencies, and uncalibrated confidence claims?
suggested_exercises: Write unit and integration tests for LLM JSON validation and 1-step structured repair.
Build a golden benchmark dataset of 20 learner profiles and evaluate roadmap completeness.
skills.mini_project: AI Reliability & Guardrail Test Harness: Automated CI verification for LLM structured outputs.
skills.source_reference: NIST AI Risk Management Framework & Pydantic Validation Docs

skills.description: Deterministic state machines, function/tool calling, structured planning pipelines, combining symbolic Python algorithms (graph topological sort, calendar schedulers) with LLM reasoning.
skills.why_relevant: Language models excel at semantic synthesis but should delegate arithmetic, calendar scheduling, and graph verification to deterministic code.
skills.completion_criteria: Build a hybrid neuro-symbolic pipeline where an LLM selects relevant curriculum nodes and a Python DAG engine validates dependencies and computes calendar dates.
skills.diagnostic_check: Why should calendar date arithmetic and topological dependency sorting be executed in deterministic Python code rather than inside an LLM prompt?
suggested_exercises: Define typed tool schemas and connect an LLM planner to a Python topological scheduler.
Implement timeout, retry, and circuit-breaker patterns around local model inference.
skills.mini_project: Neuro-Symbolic Learning Planner: Combine Ollama structured inference with Python graph scheduling.
skills.source_reference: Ollama Tool Calling Documentation & Python Graph Algorithms

skills.description: Domain adaptation of open-weight models using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), quantization (4-bit/8-bit GGUF/bitsandbytes), instruction dataset curation, and overfitting prevention.
skills.why_relevant: Useful when prompt engineering and RAG are insufficient for specialized output formats, domain jargon, or compact local model deployment.
skills.completion_criteria: Curate a validated instruction dataset, fine-tune a small open-weight model with LoRA, export to GGUF for Ollama, and benchmark against the base model.
skills.diagnostic_check: When should you prefer RAG over fine-tuning, and how does LoRA reduce trainable parameter memory during fine-tuning?
suggested_exercises: Format a 500-example JSON Schema instruction dataset and inspect token length distributions.
Create a custom Modelfile in Ollama with tuned system prompts and quantized weights.
skills.mini_project: Quantized Domain Adapter: Export and benchmark a customized local Ollama model.
skills.source_reference: Hugging Face PEFT Documentation & Ollama Modelfile Reference

skills.skill_name: Backend API Engineering (Flask / REST & Schema Validation)
skills.description: HTTP semantics, RESTful routing, request/response validation with Pydantic, error handling, CORS security, SQLite connection management, and API testing.
skills.why_relevant: Bridges AI planning models and databases with interactive frontend applications through clean, validated HTTP contracts.
skills.completion_criteria: Build a Flask REST API with Pydantic request/response validation, SQLite persistence, structured error responses, and automated integration tests.
skills.diagnostic_check: How do you structure a Flask endpoint so invalid client payloads return 400 validation errors while upstream AI timeouts return 503 without leaking stack traces?
suggested_exercises: Implement POST and PATCH endpoints in Flask with strict JSON Schema validation.
Write integration tests verifying status codes, database persistence, and error payloads.
skills.mini_project: Validated AI Bridge API: Flask backend serving validated roadmaps and persisting learner progress in SQLite.
skills.source_reference: O*NET 15-1252.00 / Official Flask Documentation (flask.palletsprojects.com)

skills.description: Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, environment variable configuration, volume persistence for SQLite/models, service networking, and health checks.
skills.why_relevant: Ensures applications, APIs, and ML models run reproducibly across local development machines and production servers.
skills.completion_criteria: Containerize a full-stack Python + React application with environment-driven configuration, health checks, and persistent storage.
skills.diagnostic_check: How do you configure a containerized Flask backend to communicate with a host or sidecar Ollama service via environment variables?
suggested_exercises: Write a multi-stage Dockerfile that builds a Vite frontend and serves it alongside a Python API.
Configure healthcheck endpoints and non-root container execution.
skills.mini_project: Reproducible Stack Deployment: Package an AI service with documented environment config and health verification.
skills.source_reference: O*NET 15-1252.00 / Official Docker Documentation (docs.docker.com)

skills.description: Model versioning, dataset lineage, latency/throughput telemetry, data drift detection, and automated retraining triggers.
skills.why_relevant: Models degrade in production when input distributions shift; MLOps ensures sustained reliability and reproducibility.
skills.completion_criteria: Log model hyperparameters, dataset hashes, and evaluation metrics to a structured registry and implement drift alerts on input features.
skills.diagnostic_check: What is the difference between covariate shift and concept drift in a deployed machine learning model?
suggested_exercises: Track experiment runs with versioned dataset checksums and confusion matrix artifacts.
Implement a Population Stability Index (PSI) check on incoming feature distributions.
skills.mini_project: Model Registry & Drift Monitor: Track model versions and alert on distribution shifts.
skills.source_reference: ESCO MLOps / Made With ML Production Guide

skills.description: Semantic document structure, accessibility landmarks, Flexbox, CSS Grid, responsive breakpoints, custom properties, and utility-first styling with Tailwind CSS.
skills.why_relevant: Forms the structural and visual foundation of every web interface across desktop and mobile devices.
skills.completion_criteria: Build a responsive, keyboard-accessible two-column workspace layout using semantic HTML5 landmarks, CSS Grid, and Flexbox without horizontal overflow.
skills.diagnostic_check: When should you use CSS Grid versus Flexbox, and why do semantic tags (<main>, <nav>, <button>) matter for screen readers and keyboard navigation?
suggested_exercises: Construct a responsive 1440px desktop to 375px mobile layout using CSS Grid and Tailwind utilities.
Audit and fix color contrast and focus-visible states across interactive form controls.
skills.mini_project: Responsive Technical Documentation Portal: Clean semantic layout with zero-overflow responsive grids.
skills.source_reference: O*NET 15-1254.00 / MDN Web Docs HTML & CSS Learning Pathway

skills.description: Closures, lexical scope, array higher-order methods (map, filter, reduce), DOM manipulation, event loop, Promises, async/await, and Fetch API.
skills.why_relevant: Powers all interactive browser behavior, asynchronous API communication, and client-side state transformations.
skills.completion_criteria: Build an interactive data explorer using async/await Fetch requests, abort controllers, immutable array transformations, and error states.
skills.diagnostic_check: How does the JavaScript event loop handle microtasks (Promises) versus macrotasks (setTimeout), and how do you handle network errors in async/await?
suggested_exercises: Write pure data transformation functions converting flat records into nested tree graphs.
Implement a debounced search controller with Fetch AbortController support.
skills.mini_project: Interactive Dependency Explorer in Vanilla JS: Fetch JSON graphs and filter nodes dynamically.
skills.source_reference: O*NET 15-1254.00 / MDN JavaScript Guide & javascript.info

skills.description: Static typing, interfaces, discriminated unions, generics, type narrowing, utility types (Partial, Record, Pick), and strict null safety.
skills.why_relevant: Eliminates whole classes of runtime errors by enforcing strict contracts between backend JSON schemas and frontend UI components.
skills.completion_criteria: Model a complete API domain using discriminated unions and generics with strict TypeScript compilation (tsc --noEmit) passing with zero any types.
skills.diagnostic_check: How do discriminated union types help TypeScript narrow component state across loading, error, and populated responses?
suggested_exercises: Define strict TypeScript interfaces mirroring backend Pydantic models.
Write generic helper functions for indexing and filtering graph nodes by status.
skills.mini_project: Strictly Typed Graph State Library: Zero-any TypeScript module for DAG traversal and filtering.
skills.source_reference: O*NET 15-1252.00 / Official TypeScript Handbook (typescriptlang.org)

skills.description: Functional components, hooks (useState, useMemo, useCallback, useEffect), controlled forms, derived state, custom hooks, and interactive graph rendering with React Flow.
skills.why_relevant: Enables building rich, stateful workspaces such as interactive mind maps, dynamic forms, and synchronized schedule views.
skills.completion_criteria: Build a multi-view React workspace with controlled form validation, synchronized graph and timeline views, and persistent state updates.
skills.diagnostic_check: Why should derived state (such as filtered skill counts or progress percentages) be computed during render or with useMemo rather than duplicated in useEffect?
suggested_exercises: Build a controlled multi-skill selector with proficiency levels and inline validation.
Render an interactive node-edge graph using @xyflow/react with custom node components and detail drawers.
skills.mini_project: Interactive Learning Workspace: Multi-view React app synchronizing a mind map, calendar schedule, and resource library.
skills.source_reference: O*NET 15-1252.00 / Official React Documentation (react.dev)

skills.description: Keyboard navigation, focus management, ARIA roles, WCAG AA contrast ratios, non-hue-only status indicators, and mobile/desktop adaptive ergonomics.
skills.why_relevant: Ensures complex interactive interfaces like mind maps and forms remain usable by everyone across keyboard, screen reader, desktop, and mobile contexts.
skills.completion_criteria: Verify all interactive controls have keyboard focus rings, >=4.5:1 text contrast, explicit text+icon status labels, and mobile drawer responsiveness.
skills.diagnostic_check: Why is signaling node status by red/green color alone an accessibility failure, and how do you pair color with iconography and explicit labels?
suggested_exercises: Navigate an entire form and graph workspace using only Tab, Enter, Space, and Escape keys.
Replace color-only badges with dual-coded icon + text status indicators.
skills.mini_project: WCAG AA Interface Audit: Upgrade an interactive graph workspace for full keyboard and color-blind accessibility.
skills.source_reference: W3C WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices & MDN Accessibility Guide

skills.description: OWASP Top 10 protections, parameterized SQL queries (preventing SQL injection), XSS prevention, CORS policies, rate limiting, and safe secret handling.
skills.why_relevant: Protects user data and backend infrastructure from injection attacks, unauthorized access, and leaked credentials.
skills.completion_criteria: Audit all database queries for parameterized bindings, enforce strict schema validation on all inputs, and isolate upstream AI configuration in environment variables.
skills.diagnostic_check: How do parameterized SQL queries prevent SQL injection compared to string interpolation?
suggested_exercises: Replace any string-formatted SQL statements with parameterized ? placeholders.
Implement input length and schema bounds validation on all API endpoints.
skills.mini_project: Security Hardening Audit: Harden a Flask + SQLite web service against OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.
skills.source_reference: OWASP Top 10 Security Cheat Sheet Series (cheatsheetseries.owasp.org)

skills.description: Unit testing pure business logic, dependency graph cycle tests, schedule boundary tests, API integration tests, and regression suites.
skills.why_relevant: Verifies that scheduling algorithms, prerequisite graphs, and API endpoints behave deterministically under edge cases.
skills.completion_criteria: Write an automated Python test suite covering topological sorting, circular dependency detection, impossible deadline handling, and SQLite persistence.
skills.diagnostic_check: What boundary cases must you test when verifying a study schedule generator against learner capacity and prerequisite chains?
suggested_exercises: Write unit tests verifying that no dependent skill is ever scheduled before its prerequisite completes.
Test API error handling when the local AI model returns malformed JSON or times out.
skills.mini_project: Comprehensive Backend Test Suite: Automated unittest/pytest verification of planning and persistence logic.
skills.source_reference: O*NET 15-1252.00 / Python unittest & pytest Official Documentation

prerequisites.justification: Requires fluency in Python syntax, indexing, and functions before manipulating multi-dimensional NumPy arrays.
Understanding vectors, dot products, and matrix dimensions helps apply vectorized array operations meaningfully.
Pandas DataFrames build directly on Python data structures, callables, and iteration patterns.
Pandas Series and DataFrames are backed by NumPy arrays, boolean masking, and vectorized dtypes.
Relational joins, filtering, and group-by aggregations in Pandas mirror SQL relational semantics.
Exploratory data visualization requires reshaped, cleaned DataFrames and aggregated summary tables.
Statistical concepts (distributions, quantiles, correlations) guide which visual encodings are appropriate.
scikit-learn estimators consume and output NumPy feature matrices and target vectors.
Training supervised models requires clean tabular datasets prepared with Pandas.
Linear models, SVMs, PCA, and gradient optimization rely directly on linear algebra and calculus.
Feature transformers and leak-free pipelines are designed to feed and optimize supervised ML estimators.
Evaluating confusion matrices, Precision, Recall, and F1 requires trained classification models and validation splits.
Probability calibration and statistical confidence intervals depend on conditional probability theory.
Deep learning extends supervised learning concepts (loss functions, regularization, train/val splits, gradient descent).
Backpropagation and tensor transformations are direct applications of matrix calculus and the chain rule.
Programmatic LLM integration, JSON Schema validation, and retry loops are implemented in Python.

Understanding Transformer attention and next-token probability distributions enriches LLM engineering, though learners can build applications with pretrained models before mastering PyTorch training from scratch.
Building semantic search and embedding indexing pipelines requires Python programming fluency.
Vector embeddings are numerical arrays queried via cosine similarity and dot products.
Semantic retrieval pairs embedding models with LLM context windows and tokenization rules.
RAG systems depend on dense/hybrid embedding retrieval to supply grounded context chunks.
Synthesizing grounded responses with citations requires structured LLM prompting and schema validation.
Metadata filtering and authoritative document catalogs are stored in relational databases alongside vector indices.
Evaluating groundedness, citation faithfulness, and schema compliance applies directly to RAG and LLM pipelines.
Testing structured LLM outputs and automated repair loops requires foundational LLM API engineering.
Multi-step orchestration builds on grounded retrieval and structured tool schemas.
LoRA and QLoRA modify neural network weight matrices and benefit from PyTorch training loop fluency.
Fine-tuning should only be undertaken after establishing strong prompting and evaluation baselines.
Building Flask backend routes and Pydantic models requires core Python proficiency.
Backend APIs persist and query application state in relational databases like SQLite and PostgreSQL.
Containerization packages a working backend API service and its runtime dependencies.
Reproducible container builds are versioned and triggered from clean Git repositories.
Production ML monitoring and model serving build upon containerized deployment pipelines.
Production monitoring tracks the same evaluation and calibration metrics established during validation.
JavaScript manipulates the DOM structure and CSS styles defined in HTML documents.
